about: HOW A PERSON SAYS A BOAT: the names the price file does not carry in words, each with where it was read. Read by src/domain/quote/spoken.ts and nothing else. A model the file already names in words (Stacer, Stabicraft, Formosa, Jeanneau, Surtees, Haines Signature, and Highfield's Coaster) is said in the file's own words and is not in this ledger. Highfield's register carries only a code per model (boat_highfield.model, e.g. ADV7, SP560); each code below is named by the maker's own page for that model, read on the date given, and the letters the page does not name (ST, EW, LS, FT, LT, KAM, AL, WL(Windlass)) are kept as the file writes them. A code no page names is under `unnamed` and is shown as the code it is. Nothing here is a guess: where the maker and the file do not decode a thing, it is not decoded.

makers.source: Every one of the register's 588 rows writes "Highfield - " before its model (Boat Module!C, e.g. "Highfield - ADV7 (HYP) B-G-B"); the register is filed as "Highfield Inflatables".
Every row writes "Stacer - " before its model (Boat Module!C, e.g. "Stacer - 519 Sea Ranger SDF (Centre Console)").
Every row writes "Stabicraft - " before its model (Boat Module!C, e.g. "Stabicraft - 1450 Explorer").
Every row writes "Formosa - " before its model (Boat Module!C, e.g. "Formosa - GRT 425 (Tiller)").
The register is filed as "Jeanneau" and four rows write "Jeanneau - " before their model (Boat Module!C, e.g. "Jeanneau - DB 37 OB"); the rest begin with the range, "Merry Fisher" or "Cap Camarat".

The register is filed as "Surtees" and five rows write "Surtees - " before their model (Boat Module!C, e.g. "Surtees - 620 Game Fisher"); one row writes "Surtess - ", a misspelling of this maker recorded under `misspelt`.
The register is filed as "Haines Signature"; its rows begin with the range, "Signature Fisher - 525F".

unnamed.why: Highfield's site has no page for it: https://www.highfieldboats.com/boat/the-sport-range/sport-300/ answered with the home page on 2026-09-24, and neither the Sport range page nor the archive of past models lists a Sport 300. It is shown as the code the file writes.

materials.name: Hypalon
materials.source: The maker offers two tube materials, "ORCA® Hypalon or PVC tube" (Standard Features, https://www.highfieldboats.com/boat/the-sport-range/sport-560/, read 2026-09-24), and the file writes two, HYP and PVC. The file's own decals column (boat_highfield.kn) reads "Rego Decals (Std) t/s Hypalon Tubes" on 307 of the 328 HYP rows that carry a decals line, and the production HelmLogic review of this sheet reads HYP as "Hypalon/CSM" (HIGHFIELD_DATA_REVIEW.md:79). The 21 HYP rows whose decals line says PVC, and the 21 PVC rows whose line says Hypalon, are the file disagreeing with itself and are left for the dealer.

materials.name: PVC
materials.source: PVC is the word itself: the maker writes "PVC tube" and the file's decals column "t/s PVC Tubes" on 202 of the 223 PVC rows that carry a decals line.

units.label: OA Length
units.source: The maker states Overall Length in metres: "Overall Length 6.98m" for the ADV7 (https://adventure.highfieldboats.com/boat/adv/adv7/) where the file writes 6.98, and "Overall Length 2.30m" for the Roll Up 230 (https://www.highfieldboats.com/boat/roll-up/roll-up-230/) where the file writes 2.3. Read 2026-09-24.

units.label: Beam
units.source: The maker states the width in metres: "Width 2.68m" for the ADV7 (https://adventure.highfieldboats.com/boat/adv/adv7/) where the file's Beam is 2.68, and "Overall Width 1.37m" for the Roll Up 230 (https://www.highfieldboats.com/boat/roll-up/roll-up-230/) where it is 1.37. Read 2026-09-24.

units.label: Hull Length
units.source: The maker states "Overall Length 4950 mm" for the 495 Pro Fisher (https://www.surteesboats.com/our-range/boat/495-pro-fisher) where the file writes 4.95: the same length in metres. Read 2026-09-24.

units.label: Beam
units.source: The maker states "Beam 2010mm" for the 495 Pro Fisher (https://www.surteesboats.com/our-range/boat/495-pro-fisher) where the file writes 2.01: the same beam in metres. Read 2026-09-24.

words.source: The file writes the one engine count both ways in one column: Dealer Fit Module!R2177 "Helm Master EX - Sng Eng | 6x9 Side Mnt | …" and Dealer Fit Module!R428 "Add On Kit - Bolt On Digital Electric Steering | Straight Helm | Single Engine". In Rigging Kits the single-engine DEC kit carries the "6X6 Sng Key Switch" (R429) where the twin-engine kit carries the "6Y8 Twin Key Switch" (R394), and Helm Master kits end "| EKS | Single" (R446). Every one of the file's 120 words "Sng", read on 2026-09-24, stands where one of a thing is meant — Sng Key, Sng Eng, Sng Position, Sng Arm, Sng Ram, and "Sng UL / Twin XL" for shafts.

Dealer Fit Module!R2177 names its control "6x9 Side Mnt" in the Package column and "6X9 DEC Flush Side Mount Control Box" in its own Accessory (Primary) column; Dealer Fit Module!R443 writes "6x9 Flush Side Mount" where Rigging Kits!R422 writes "6x9 Flush Side Mnt"; and Parts & Accessories and Dealer Fit Packages each write both in one cell, "Sounder Installation - Flush Mount + Transom Mnt Transducer". Every one of the file's 166 words "Mnt", read on 2026-09-24, follows a way of mounting a thing.

misspelt.source: Boat Module!R223 writes "Surtess  -  770 Game Fisher XL" in its name column (boat_surtees.c), and the same row's own maker column (Matrix, boat_surtees.e) reads "Surtees", as it does on all 19 rows of the register. Its Model Code, SUR-770GFXL, carries the SUR of the four siblings written "Surtees - " that have one (SUR-620GF, SUR-670GF, SUR-770GF-261, SUR-800GF), the row beside it is written "Surtees  -  770 Game Fisher" with the same double spaces, and its Image Link is on www.surteesboats.com. Read 2026-09-25. The file's own string is kept verbatim for the dealer; only the name a person reads says the maker once, as Surtees.
